title.zh: 股票与债券 · 买到的到底是什么
title.en: Stocks & Bonds · What Do You Actually Buy

desc.zh: 买股票是买下公司的一小份所有权，买债券是借钱给它收利息；公司出问题时，债主先、股东后。
desc.en: Buying a stock buys a small slice of ownership; buying a bond lends money for interest — and if the company fails, lenders are paid before shareholders.
